title: Offer AI provider Fable 5.2 and make it the Fable default
summary: Fable 5.2 is the composer's Fable and the default Fable lead, and usage history prices it and its fast mode.

sections.title: What this ship changes for you
items: Fable 5.2 is the composer's Fable and the default Fable lead, and usage history prices it and its fast mode. Fable 5.1 stays selectable in Settings.
The sidebar has an Inbox, a one-row head, and the navigation in a dock at its foot.
The right panel's empty tab is one compact tool list with a letter key for each tool. Opening the Browser keeps the panel's other tabs.
The files-changed pill floats over the transcript instead of cutting it off, and an empty chat shows its heading.
Stop holds a delegated worker, and Stop all also stops a worker whose packet was archived mid-turn.
A chat's unsent draft survives a relaunch or an update.
A file pill's peek shows the file's length and its last change.
Settings › Voice › Polish edits your words, snippets and instructions. Voice Settings opens at its own size, and the dictation waveform follows your voice more closely.

sections.title: Fixes
items: Store the lane binding on delegated packets so Stop can hold them
Tell canvas callers why the canvas is unavailable without Next
Check a lane checkout's Git state before o8 commits or merges there
Serve task create and lane reap on the native transport
Limit lane workers to their own branch in shared Git metadata
Integrate the reviewed commit and fetch from the registered origin
Upgrade rusqlite to 0.41 and drop the RUSTSEC-2026-0459 hold
Lint packets with the base revision's ESLint config and install
